# Roy Quick Real Estate

> Roy Quick is a Realtor® with LUXRE Realty, Inc. (CA DRE #02417080) based at 222 Avenida Del Mar, San Clemente, CA 92672. He helps homeowners in San Clemente, Dana Point, Capistrano Beach, San Juan Capistrano and the rest of South Orange County sell or lease their homes, works with real estate investors, and specializes in relisting homes that did not sell the first time. Phone/text 980-416-6412, email roy@roysoldquick.com.

- [Home](https://roysoldquick.com/): listings, expired-listing help, about Roy, LUXRE Realty, contact

## Recent market updates
- [Sell or Lease Your San Clemente Home? November 2026 Market Update](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/sell-or-lease-san-clemente-home-november-2026/): San Clemente 3-bedroom rentals average about $6,500 a month while rates dip to 7.24%. Roy Quick runs the sell-or-lease math for South OC homeowners, plus Capistrano Beach and Norte Fire updates.
- [San Clemente Housing Market Update: October 2026](https://roysoldquick.com/market-updates/san-clemente-housing-market-update-october-2026/): San Clemente home prices rose about 4% year over year while inventory tightened, Dana Point jumped 16.6%, and rates sit near 7.3%. Roy Quick breaks down what it means for South OC sellers, landlords and investors.
